summary: RoyaLand Co Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, furnishing a press release reviewing September performance of its Italian football club Savoia 1908 FC. The disclosure covers league results, a Coppa Italia Serie C Round-of-16 run with a 3-0 away win over Catania, and season objectives. No transaction, stake change, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic appears. This is an ordinary operational and investor-relations update by a Bermuda-domiciled OTCQB issuer, not a special situation; watch only for future fundraising or ownership moves.
